Lower Text: [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
Upper Text: [Main] Your Digimon in the breeding area may digivolve into [Lucemon] in your trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.

・By digivolving 1 of your Digimon with [Lucemon] in its name into a Digimon card with [Lucemon] in its name in the trash, trash 1 of your opponent's Option cards in the battle area. When this effect would digivolve, reduce the digivolution cost by 3.
